description: This Java class defines services for managing payment methods, including creating, updating, deleting, and expiring payment methods such as credit cards, gift cards, EFT accounts, and check accounts within the OFBiz framework. It includes security checks, entity manipulations, and utility functions related to payment entities.

classes.name: PaymentMethodServices
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing payment methods, including creation, update, deletion, and expiration of credit cards, gift cards, EFT accounts, and check accounts within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Marks a PaymentMethod entity as expired by setting its 'thruDate' to current timestamp, with security checks for permission.

methods.name: makeExpireDate
methods.description: Constructs an expiration date string from month and year parameters.

methods.name: createCreditCard
methods.description: Creates new CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation and security checks.

methods.name: updateCreditCard
methods.description: Updates existing CreditCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation, including masking and date checks.

methods.name: clearCreditCardData
methods.description: Clears sensitive credit card data and expires the associated payment method.

methods.name: createGiftCard
methods.description: Creates new GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateGiftCard
methods.description: Updates existing GiftCard and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: createEftAccount
methods.description: Creates new EFT account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateEftAccount
methods.description: Updates existing EFT account and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: createCheckAccount
methods.description: Creates new CheckAccount and PaymentMethod entities with validation.

methods.name: updateCheckAccount
methods.description: Updates existing CheckAccount and PaymentMethod entities with validation.
